queries: WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.rate) AS avg_rate_above, AVG(r.cnt) AS avg_track_count, AVG(r.rate - a.avg_rate) AS avg_excess FROM r CROSS JOIN a WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate

WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.rate) AS avg_rate_above, AVG(r.track_count * 1.0) AS avg_track_count, AVG(r.rate - a.avg_rate) AS avg_excess FROM r CROSS JOIN a WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate

responses.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.rate) AS avg_rate_above, AVG(r.cnt) AS avg_track_count, AVG(r.rate - a.avg_rate) AS avg_excess FROM r CROSS JOIN a WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate

assumptions.assumption: Rate is computed as SUM(Bytes)/SUM(Milliseconds) using decimal (non-integer) division. Tracks with NULL Bytes add to the Milliseconds total but not the Bytes total, because SUM skips NULLs. Tracks are counted regardless of whether Bytes is NULL.
The overall average is the simple, unweighted mean of the per-media-type rates, taken over all groups before the filter. The filter is strictly greater than that mean.

responses.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / NULLIF(SUM(t.Milliseconds), 0) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.rate) AS avg_rate_above, AVG(r.track_count * 1.0) AS avg_track_count, AVG(r.rate - a.avg_rate) AS avg_excess FROM r CROSS JOIN a WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate

assumptions.assumption: An inner join of Track to MediaType keeps only tracks with a media type. Media types with no tracks are excluded, and the overall average is taken over the types that remain.
The rate is SUM(Bytes)/SUM(Milliseconds) with floating-point division and no rounding. SUM skips NULL Bytes. The track count is COUNT(*) of the tracks in each group.

responses.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.rate) AS avg_rate_of_above, AVG(r.track_count) AS avg_track_count, AVG(r.rate - a.avg_rate) AS avg_excess FROM r CROSS JOIN a WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate

assumptions.assumption: Tracks are inner-joined to MediaType, so media types with no tracks are excluded. Track count is COUNT(*) of the tracks in each group. Bytes is nullable, and SUM ignores NULL Bytes while those tracks still count toward the track count.
Division is done as a decimal or float (multiplying by 1.0) to avoid integer truncation. No rounding is applied.
